dialogues.jp: 昼休みに入った教室で伸びをする。
dialogues.en: Still in the classroom, I stretched as noon approached.
dialogues.text: Still in the classroom, I stretched as noon approached.

dialogues.jp:
まだ午後の授業もあるけど、先ほどの自習の分、
体力は存分に保持されていた。
dialogues.en:
There's still lessons in the afternoon which won't be
self-studies, so I'd have to keep my energy up.
dialogues.text:
There's still lessons in the afternoon which won't be
self-studies, so I'd have to keep my energy up.

dialogues.jp: 「さてと、今日はどうするかな」

昼休みに入り、伸びをして、さてどうしような
どと考える。
dialogues.en:
As lunch break approached, I stretched and thought of what
to do.
dialogues.text:
As lunch break approached, I stretched and thought of what
to do.
